import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    n = len(df)
    reason_lists = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    # R1: amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 -> AMT_BAD
    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)

    # R2: tax IS NULL OR tax < 0 -> TAX_BAD
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)

    # R3: tax > amount * 0.5, NULL-safe (skip if amount or tax is NULL)
    both_present = amount.notna() & tax.notna()
    r3 = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    r3[both_present] = tax[both_present] > (amount[both_present] * 0.5)

    # R4: due_date IS NULL -> DUE_NULL
    r4 = due_date.isna()

    # R5: customer_ref IS NULL OR TRIM(customer_ref) = '' -> REF_EMPTY
    def is_empty_ref(v):
        if pd.isna(v):
            return True
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return v.strip() == ""
        return False

    r5 = customer_ref.apply(is_empty_ref)

    rules = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    for mask, code in rules:
        mask_arr = mask.to_numpy()
        for i, flag in enumerate(mask_arr):
            if flag:
                reason_lists[i].append(code)

    reason_codes = ["|".join(codes) if codes else "" for codes in reason_lists]
    has_failure = [len(codes) > 0 for codes in reason_lists]

    clean_mask = pd.Series([not f for f in has_failure], index=df.index)
    reject_mask = pd.Series(has_failure, index=df.index)

    invoices_clean = df[clean_mask].copy()

    invoices_rejects = df[reject_mask].copy()
    invoices_rejects["reason_codes"] = pd.Series(reason_codes, index=df.index)[reject_mask]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects,
    }
